```{r}
data_raw <- read_excel("mole crabs fixed swash and temp.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    water_temp = as.numeric(str_extract(water_temp, "[0-9.]+")),
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = factor(year(date))
  )
```

```{r}
clean_data <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(
    # ===========================
    # STANDARDIZE LOCATION
    # ===========================
    location = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(location), "brighton|bluff") ~ "bluffs",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "south bath|bath ave") ~ "south_bath",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "deal|allenhurst|roosevelt") ~ "deal",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "ocean grove") ~ "ocean_grove",
      str_detect(tolower(location), "sandy hook") ~ "sandy_hook",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN WAVES
    # ===========================
    waves_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "small|\\bsm\\b") ~ "Small",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "med") ~ "Medium",
      str_detect(tolower(waves_sm_med_large), "large|rough|3-5") ~ "Large",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN ZONE
    # ===========================
    zone = tolower(zone),
    zone = case_when(
      str_detect(zone, "bore")  ~ "bore",
      str_detect(zone, "swash|surf") ~ "swash",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN ENVIRONMENTAL NUMERIC VARIABLES
    # ===========================
    salinity_raw = as.numeric(str_extract(salinity, "[0-9.]+")),
    do_mg_l_raw = as.numeric(str_extract(do_mg_l, "[0-9.]+")),
    air_temp_deg_c = as.numeric(str_extract(air_temp_deg_c, "[0-9.]+")),

    # ===========================
    # FIX SALINITY
    # ===========================
    salinity = case_when(
      salinity_raw < 20 ~ NA_real_,
      salinity_raw > 45 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ salinity_raw
    ),

    # ===========================
    # FIX DO
    # ===========================
    do_mg_l = case_when(
      do_mg_l_raw > 20 ~ NA_real_,
      do_mg_l_raw <= 0 ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ do_mg_l_raw
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN MOON PHASE
    # ===========================
    moon_phase_clean = tolower(moon_phase),
    moon_phase_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "full") ~ "Full",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "first|waxing") ~ "Waxing",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "last|waning") ~ "Waning",
      str_detect(moon_phase_clean, "quarter|quater") ~ "Quarter",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN TIDE STAGE
    # ===========================
    tide_clean = tolower(tide_stage),
    tide_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(tide_clean, "high") ~ "High",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "low|\\bl\\b") ~ "Low",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "rising|flood|incoming") ~ "Rising",
      str_detect(tide_clean, "falling|ebb") ~ "Falling",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN SKY
    # ===========================
    sky_clean = tolower(sky),
    sky_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(sky_clean, "clear|sun") ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(sky_clean, "part") ~ "Partly Cloudy",
      str_detect(sky_clean, "cloud") ~ "Cloudy",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN FOAM
    # ===========================
    foam_clean = tolower(foam_floatables_y_n),
    foam_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(foam_clean, "y|foam") ~ "Foam",
      str_detect(foam_clean, "n|none|little") ~ "No Foam",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ===========================
    # CLEAN WATER CLARITY
    # ===========================
    water_clean = tolower(water_color_transparency),
    water_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(water_clean, "clear|transparent|high transparency") ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(water_clean, "murky|low transparency|dark|brown|grey|cloudy") ~ "Murky",
      str_detect(water_clean, "green|olive|yellow|blue") ~ "Moderate",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%

  # Remove helper column
  dplyr::select(-do_mg_l_raw, -salinity_raw) %>%

  # Keep valid locations only
  filter(!is.na(location)) %>%

  mutate(
  location = factor(location),
  year = factor(year, levels = sort(unique(year))),
  waves_clean = factor(waves_clean, levels = c("Small","Medium","Large")),
  zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
  moon_phase_clean = factor(moon_phase_clean,
                            levels = c("Waxing","Full","Waning","Quarter")),
  tide_clean = factor(tide_clean,
                      levels = c("Low","Rising","High","Falling")),
  sky_clean = factor(sky_clean,
                     levels = c("Clear","Partly Cloudy","Cloudy")),
  foam_clean = factor(foam_clean,
                      levels = c("No Foam","Foam")),
  water_clean = factor(water_clean,
                       levels = c("Clear","Moderate","Murky"))
) %>%
droplevels()
global_temp_mean <- mean(clean_data$water_temp, na.rm = TRUE)


clean_data <- clean_data %>%
  mutate(
    phase = case_when(
      year %in% c("2021","2022") ~ "Baseline",
      year == "2023" ~ "Disturbance",
      year == "2024" ~ "Collapse",
      year == "2025" ~ "Recovery"
    ),
    phase = factor(
      phase,
      levels = c("Baseline","Disturbance","Collapse","Recovery")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# CREATE LONG FORMAT SIZE DATA
# ----------------------------------

size_data <- clean_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    date,
    water_temp,
    salinity,
    do_mg_l,
    air_temp_deg_c,
    waves_clean,
    location,
    year,
    phase,
    zone,
    groin,            
    scoops,
    ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    ct_2mm  = as.numeric(ct_2mm),
    ct_6mm  = as.numeric(ct_6mm),
    ct_12mm = as.numeric(ct_12mm),
    
    # Clean  
    groin = case_when(
      groin %in% c("N","n") ~ "North",
      groin %in% c("S","s") ~ "South",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ct_2mm, ct_6mm, ct_12mm),
    names_to = "size_class",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    size_class = factor(
      size_class,
      levels = c("ct_2mm","ct_6mm","ct_12mm"),
      labels = c("Small (2mm)",
                 "Medium (6mm)",
                 "Large (12mm+)")
    ),
    count = ifelse(is.na(count), 0, count),
    
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    groin = factor(groin, levels = c("North","South")),
  ) %>%
  
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# OBSERVED TEMPORAL TREND
# (CRABS PER SCOOP)

observed_size <- size_data %>%
  group_by(year, size_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_per_scoop = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean_per_scoop - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean_per_scoop + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year_num = as.numeric(as.character(year))
  )

ggplot(observed_size,
       aes(x = year_num,
           y = mean_per_scoop,
           color = size_class,
           fill = size_class,
           group = size_class)) +
  
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower,
                  ymax = upper),
              alpha = 0.15,
              color = NA) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crab_colors) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = sort(unique(observed_size$year_num))
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",

    color = "Size Class",
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# BIOMASS TRAJECTORY BY YEAR (Aligned Version)
# ==========================================

biomass_year <- size_data %>%
  filter(
    year %in% c("2021","2022","2023","2024","2025"),
    zone %in% c("bore","swash"),
    !location %in% c("sandy_hook"),
    scoops > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    size_mm = case_when(
      size_class == "Small (2mm)"   ~ 2,
      size_class == "Medium (6mm)"  ~ 6,
      size_class == "Large (12mm+)" ~ 12
    ),
    biomass_proxy = count * size_mm
  ) %>%
  group_by(zone, year, phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_biomass = mean(biomass_proxy, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(biomass_proxy, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    lower = mean_biomass - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean_biomass + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(year_num = as.numeric(as.character(year)))

# ==========================================
# LABEL POSITIONS
# ==========================================

baseline_y <- biomass_year %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022")) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(mean_biomass)) %>%
  pull(val)

collapse_y <- biomass_year %>%
  filter(year == "2024") %>%
  summarise(val = mean(mean_biomass)) %>%
  pull(val)

disturb_y <- biomass_year %>%
  filter(year == "2023") %>%
  summarise(val = mean(mean_biomass)) %>%
  pull(val)

swash_2025_y <- biomass_year %>%
  filter(year == "2025", zone == "swash") %>%
  pull(mean_biomass)

bore_2025_y <- biomass_year %>%
  filter(year == "2025", zone == "bore") %>%
  pull(mean_biomass)

# ==========================================
# PLOT
# ==========================================

ggplot(biomass_year,
       aes(x = year_num,
           y = mean_biomass,
           color = zone,
           fill = zone,
           group = zone)) +

  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              alpha = 0.18,
              color = NA) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +

  # ---- Phase Labels ----
  annotate("text",
           x = 2021.5,
           y = baseline_y + 1,
           label = "Baseline",
           color = "darkgreen",
           fontface = "bold",
           size = 5) +

  annotate("text",
           x = 2023.2,
           y = disturb_y + 1,
           label = "Disturbance",
           color = "red",
           fontface = "bold",
           size = 5) +

  annotate("text",
           x = 2023.8,
           y = collapse_y + 1,
           label = "Collapse",
           color = "red",
           fontface = "bold",
           size = 5) +

  annotate("text",
           x = 2024.2,
           y = swash_2025_y + 1,
           label = "Swash Recovery",
           color = "limegreen",
           fontface = "bold",
           hjust = 0,
           size = 5) +

  annotate("text",
           x = 2025,
           y = bore_2025_y + 6,
           label = "Bore Suppression",
           color = "darkgreen",
           fontface = "bold",
           hjust = 1.05,
           size = 5) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "bore"  = "darkgreen",
    "swash" = "limegreen"
  )) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "bore"  = "darkgreen",
    "swash" = "limegreen"
  )) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2021,2022,2023,2024,2025)) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20)

  labs(
    x = "Year",

  )

ggsave("biomass.png",
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# CRAMÉR'S V — BASELINE vs DISTURBANCE
# (SCOOP-WEIGHTED VERSION)
# ==========================================

struct_data <- clean_data %>%
  filter(location != "sandy_hook",
         scoops > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      year %in% c("2021","2022") ~ "Baseline",
      year %in% c("2023","2024") ~ "Disturbance"
    ),
    total = ct_2mm + ct_6mm + ct_12mm
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(period),
         total > 0) %>%   # exclude zero-total samples for composition test
  mutate(
    dominant_size = case_when(
      ct_2mm  >= ct_6mm & ct_2mm  >= ct_12mm ~ "Small",
      ct_6mm  >= ct_2mm & ct_6mm  >= ct_12mm ~ "Medium",
      ct_12mm >= ct_2mm & ct_12mm >= ct_6mm  ~ "Large"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(period, dominant_size) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),      # <-- scoop-weighted
    .groups = "drop"
  )

matrix_bd <- xtabs(n_samples ~ period + dominant_size,
                   data = struct_data)

chi_disturbance <- chisq.test(matrix_bd)

# Cramér's V
n_bd <- sum(matrix_bd)
min_dim_bd <- min(dim(matrix_bd) - 1)

cramers_v_disturbance <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(chi_disturbance$statistic) /
  (n_bd * min_dim_bd)
)

print(matrix_bd)
print(chi_disturbance)
print(cramers_v_disturbance)
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------
# ANALYSIS DATASET
# ----------------------------------

analysis_data <- size_data %>%
  filter(!location %in% c("sandy_hook", "ocean_grove")) %>%
  filter(scoops > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    log_scoops = log(scoops),
    water_temp_c = water_temp - global_temp_mean,
    salinity_c = salinity - mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    do_c = do_mg_l - mean(do_mg_l, na.rm = TRUE),
    air_temp_c = air_temp_deg_c - mean(air_temp_deg_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    zone = factor(zone, levels = c("bore","swash")),
    groin = factor(groin, levels = c("North","South")),
    year = factor(year)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(count, scoops, size_class, location, year) %>%
  droplevels()

analysis_data$year <- relevel(analysis_data$year, ref = "2021")
analysis_data$location <- relevel(analysis_data$location, ref = "deal")
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# SYSTEMATIC TWO-WAY INTERACTION TEST
# ==========================================
# ------------------------------------------
# 1. Baseline main-effects model
# ------------------------------------------

nb_main <- glmmTMB(
  count ~ log_scoops  +
          year + zone + size_class + water_temp_c +
          location + (1 | date),
  family = nbinom2,
  data = analysis_data
)

# ------------------------------------------
# 2. Define variables to test
# ------------------------------------------

vars <- c("year",
          "zone",
          "size_class",
          "water_temp_c")

two_way_terms <- combn(vars, 2,
                       FUN = function(x) paste(x, collapse=":"))

# ------------------------------------------
# 3. Test each interaction via LRT
# ------------------------------------------

interaction_results <- lapply(two_way_terms, function(term){

  model_int <- update(nb_main,
                      as.formula(paste(". ~ . +", term)))

  test <- anova(nb_main, model_int)

  data.frame(
    Interaction = term,
    Chisq = test$Chisq[2],
    Df = test$Df[2],
    p_value = test$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
    Delta_AIC = AIC(model_int) - AIC(nb_main)
  )
})

interaction_results <- do.call(rbind, interaction_results) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

# ------------------------------------------
# 4. Print ranked results
# ------------------------------------------
print(interaction_results)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# MAXIMAL 3-WAY INTERACTION MODEL
# ============================================================

nb_full_3way <- glmmTMB(
  count ~ log_scoops +

           # All main effects
           year + zone + size_class + water_temp_c +

           # All two-way interactions
           year:zone +
        year:size_class +
        year:water_temp_c +
        zone:size_class +
        zone:water_temp_c +
        size_class:water_temp_c +

           # All possible 3-way interactions
           year:zone:size_class +
           year:zone:water_temp_c +
           year:size_class:water_temp_c +
           zone:size_class:water_temp_c +

           location + (1 | date),

  family = nbinom2,
  data = analysis_data
)

summary(nb_full_3way)
nb_no_pzs <- update(nb_full_3way,
                    . ~ . - year:zone:size_class)

anova(nb_no_pzs, nb_full_3way)
nb_no_pzt <- update(nb_full_3way,
                    . ~ . - year:zone:water_temp_c)

anova(nb_no_pzt, nb_full_3way)
nb_no_pst <- update(nb_full_3way,
                    . ~ . - year:size_class:water_temp_c)

anova(nb_no_pst, nb_full_3way)
nb_no_zst <- update(nb_full_3way,
                    . ~ . - zone:size_class:water_temp_c)

anova(nb_no_zst, nb_full_3way)
lrt_results <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(
    Term = "Year:Zone:Size",
    anova(nb_no_pzs, nb_full_3way)[2, c("Chisq","Df","Pr(>Chisq)")]
  ),
  data.frame(
    Term = "Year:Zone:Temp",
    anova(nb_no_pzt, nb_full_3way)[2, c("Chisq","Df","Pr(>Chisq)")]
  ),
  data.frame(
    Term = "Year:Size:Temp",
    anova(nb_no_pst, nb_full_3way)[2, c("Chisq","Df","Pr(>Chisq)")]
  ),
  data.frame(
    Term = "Zone:Size:Temp",
    anova(nb_no_zst, nb_full_3way)[2, c("Chisq","Df","Pr(>Chisq)")]
  )
)

print(lrt_results)
```

```{r disturbance_clock, eval=knitr::is_html_output()}
library(DiagrammeR)

# =====================================================
# MEAN BODY SIZE (Baseline vs Recovery)
# =====================================================

mean_size_df <- size_data %>%
  filter(year %in% c("2021","2022","2025")) %>%
  mutate(
    size_mm = case_when(
      size_class == "Small (2mm)" ~ 2,
      size_class == "Medium (6mm)" ~ 6,
      size_class == "Large (12mm+)" ~ 12
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_size = sum(count * size_mm) / sum(count),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mean_size_baseline <- round(
  mean(mean_size_df$mean_size[mean_size_df$year %in% c("2021","2022")]),
  1
)

mean_size_2025 <- round(
  mean_size_df$mean_size[mean_size_df$year == "2025"],
  1
)

size_decline <- round(
  100 * (1 - mean_size_2025 / mean_size_baseline),
  1
)

# =====================================================
# BIOMASS COLLAPSE
# =====================================================

biomass_year <- size_data %>%
  filter(location != "sandy_hook",
         zone %in% c("bore","swash")) %>%
  mutate(
    size_mm = case_when(
      size_class == "Small (2mm)" ~ 2,
      size_class == "Medium (6mm)" ~ 6,
      size_class == "Large (12mm+)" ~ 12
    ),
    biomass_proxy = count * size_mm
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mean_biomass = mean(biomass_proxy), .groups="drop")

baseline_bio <- mean(
  biomass_year$mean_biomass[biomass_year$year %in% c("2021","2022")]
)

collapse_bio <- biomass_year$mean_biomass[
  biomass_year$year == "2024"
]

collapse_pct <- round(
  100 * (1 - collapse_bio / baseline_bio),
  0
)

# =====================================================
# STRUCTURAL BREAK
# =====================================================

break_chi <- round(as.numeric(chi_disturbance$statistic), 2)
break_p   <- signif(chi_disturbance$p.value, 3)
break_v   <- round(cramers_v_disturbance, 2)

break_p_text <- ifelse(
  break_p < 0.001,
  "&lt; 0.001",
  paste0("= ", break_p)
)

analysis_data$fit_resp <- predict(
  nb_full_interaction,
  type = "response",
  re.form = NA
)

disturb_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mean_pred = mean(fit_resp), .groups = "drop")

irr_val <- round(
  disturb_summary$mean_pred[disturb_summary$year == "2024"] /
  disturb_summary$mean_pred[disturb_summary$year == "2021"],
  2
)

# =====================================================
# ZONE RECOVERY
# =====================================================

zone_recovery <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(zone, year) %>%
  summarise(mean_pred = mean(fit_resp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = mean_pred) %>%
  mutate(IRR = round(`2025` / `2021`, 2))

irr_recovery_bore  <- zone_recovery$IRR[zone_recovery$zone == "bore"]
irr_recovery_swash <- zone_recovery$IRR[zone_recovery$zone == "swash"]

# =====================================================

biomass_zone <- size_data %>%
  filter(location != "sandy_hook",
         zone %in% c("bore","swash"),

  mutate(

    ),
    biomass_proxy = count * size_mm
  ) %>%
  group_by(zone, year) %>%
  summarise(mean_biomass = mean(biomass_proxy), .groups="drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = mean_biomass) %>%

swash_recovery <- biomass_zone$percent[biomass_zone$zone == "swash"]
bore_recovery  <- biomass_zone$percent[biomass_zone$zone == "bore"]

# =====================================================

repro_loss <- size_data %>%
  filter(location != "sandy_hook",
         zone %in% c("bore","swash"),

  mutate(
```
